summary_id: Pengembangan kawasan terpadu pangan, perkebunan, perikanan, dan peternakan; peningkatan produktivitas pangan pokok; pembentukan bursa komoditas pertanian strategis.
summary_en: Integrated food, plantation, fisheries and livestock areas; higher staple-food productivity; a strategic agricultural commodity exchange.
target_summary_id: Kawasan terpadu dan bursa komoditas strategis; target kuantitatif tidak dinyatakan dalam pidato.
target_summary_en: Integrated areas and a strategic commodity exchange; no quantitative target is stated in the speech.
notes: Name and priority from the 14 August 2026 speech; scope from the 16 September 2026 Finance Ministry breakdown. No programme budget or quantitative target is stated.

summary_id: Transisi energi terbarukan, termasuk 100 GW PLTS, percepatan penggantian pembangkit diesel, dan kemandirian air.
summary_en: Renewable energy transition, including 100 GWp of solar, accelerated diesel retirement, and water independence.
target_summary_id: 100 GW PLTS; 30 GW dibangun pada 2026 dan 13 GW diesel dihentikan.
target_summary_en: 100 GWp of solar; 30 GW built in 2026 and 13 GW of diesel retired.
notes: The speech states the 100 GWp solar target and the 2026 30 GW build / 13 GW diesel retirement. It does not split the target by year for 2027.

summary_id: Pemenuhan mandat 20% APBN, renovasi sekolah secara masif, modernisasi kelas dengan layar pintar interaktif, dan pembebasan biaya sekolah negeri.
summary_en: The 20% education mandate, mass school renovation, interactive flat panels, and free state schools.
target_summary_id: Anggaran pendidikan Rp820,9 triliun; renovasi seluruh sekolah selesai paling lambat 2029; IFP dan sekolah negeri gratis.
target_summary_en: Rp820.9 trillion education budget; all school renovation complete by 2029; interactive panels and free state schools.
notes: Budget from the Finance Ministry breakdown; 20% mandate, renovation deadline and free-school policy from the 14 August 2026 speech.

summary_id: Renovasi 10.000 Puskesmas, 514 Labkesmas, revitalisasi 441 RSUD, ambulans udara, dan penambahan dokter spesialis.
summary_en: Renovation of 10,000 Puskesmas and 514 Labkesmas, revitalisation of 441 RSUD, air ambulances, and more specialist doctors.
target_summary_id: 10.000 Puskesmas dan 514 Labkesmas direnovasi; 441 RSUD direvitalisasi; selesai paling lambat 2030.
target_summary_en: 10,000 Puskesmas and 514 Labkesmas renovated; 441 RSUD revitalised; complete by 2030.
notes: Targets and 2030 deadline from the speech; Rp244.9T health allocation from the Finance Ministry breakdown. The speech also cites a shortage of 84,781 general doctors, 127,580 dentists and 55,712 specialists.

summary_id: Hilirisasi komoditas hingga kendaraan listrik, panel surya, semikonduktor, rumput laut, dan kelapa untuk memperbesar nilai tambah nasional.
summary_en: Commodity downstreaming into electric vehicles, solar panels, semiconductors, seaweed and coconut to raise domestic value added.
target_summary_id: Nilai tambah dalam negeri; target kuantitatif tidak dinyatakan dalam pidato.
target_summary_en: Domestic value added; no quantitative target is stated in the speech.
notes: Scope from the Finance Ministry breakdown. The speech places hilirisasi and industrialisation among the eight PKPN but does not state a quantitative target.

summary_id: Konektivitas baru, perumahan, ketahanan terhadap bencana, dan Giant Sea Wall di Pantura Jawa.
summary_en: New connectivity, housing, disaster resilience, and the Giant Sea Wall on Java's north coast.
target_summary_id: Giant Sea Wall 15 segmen dari Banten hingga Gresik; 15–20 tahun; target kuantitatif lain tidak dinyatakan.
target_summary_en: Giant Sea Wall in 15 segments from Banten to Gresik; 15–20 years; no other quantitative target is stated.
notes: 15 segments and 15–20 year horizon from the Finance Ministry breakdown; the speech confirms the Giant Sea Wall and its urgency.

name_id: Penguatan Ekonomi Kerakyatan dan Pembangunan Desa
summary_id: Penguatan Koperasi Desa/Kelurahan Merah Putih (KDMP), program Pro-Kesra, dan produktivitas 10 juta pelaku usaha lokal.
summary_en: Strengthening village co-operatives (KDMP), the Pro-Kesra programme, and the productivity of 10 million local entrepreneurs.
target_summary_id: 10 juta pelaku usaha lokal; target kuantitatif lain tidak dinyatakan dalam pidato.
target_summary_en: 10 million local entrepreneurs; no other quantitative target is stated in the speech.
notes: 10 million local entrepreneurs and KDMP from the Finance Ministry breakdown; the speech names the people's economy and village development priority.

summary_id: Perlindungan sosial adaptif sepanjang hayat berbasis Data Tunggal Sosial Ekonomi Nasional (DTSEN) dan program graduasi kemiskinan.
summary_en: Lifelong adaptive social protection based on the national social-economic data (DTSEN) and poverty graduation programmes.
notes: Poverty, unemployment and Gini targets from the speech; Rp549.9T social protection allocation from the Finance Ministry breakdown. The allocation supports the poverty priority but is not a poverty-programme budget.
